description: Create a new preview that restores the applied, reversible changes of one edit. It does not apply the undo; the result works like any ads_edit_preview result. Archive and delete return not_reversible. In review mode the undo keeps the original run title and note with an "Undo:" prefix unless runTitle or reason is passed; reviewId adds it to an existing review.

reason.description: One short note for the user explaining why (shown in their Agent Inbox). Defaults to the original note with one "Undo: " prefix.

reviewId.description: Add the undo to this existing review instead of starting a new one.

runTitle.description: Optional one-line title for this undo. Defaults to "Undo: " plus the original run title, keeping an existing prefix.

name: ads_edit_undo
title: Preview an Undo
